'''2001 Texas State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Austin, Texas in 2001. [[Justin Warren]] won it.<ref name="dt-14976">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14976 Chain Of Command (Texas State Champion Hunt Down)], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 2 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14976/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14976/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 31 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]

Mike Richards dates the event to 31 March 2001 in Austin, Texas.<ref name="dt-14947" /> It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Warren won with his Dark Hunt Down deck, losing only one game in five (a timed loss by 10); he beat John Sneed in the final.<ref name="dt-14976" /> Michael Sneed placed 3rd, behind Warren and his brother. His Dark ISB Operations deck went 2–1 there, beating Joseph Amaya and Mike Patterson, and his Light deck went 3–0.<ref name="dt-15109" /> Ira Babb took [[Adam Montgomery]]'s Dark deck from the [[2001 Vegas DPC]] to Texas States and placed 5th.<ref name="dt-15723" /> Mike Richards' Dark Kessel deck went 3–0 and his Light Corulag deck 1–2.<ref name="dt-14947" /><ref name="dt-14950" />
